# challenge_mini — synthetic bundle in the Oct 20 file formats

Generated by `scripts/make_challenge_fixture.py --source metrica-sample-3 --seed 0` from the converted Metrica sample game (`https://github.com/metrica-sports/sample-data`, licence: No SPDX licence file. README 'Legal stuff': 'Please be responsible with the use of this data. If you use it for anything public, please aknowledge the source.' Data is offered 'to provide some sample data to play around with to the broader football analytics community'. Games 1-2 anonymised. We use it for an internal hackathon pre-build and will acknowledge Metrica Sports.); two 300-frame windows (source frames 62026–62325 of period 1 → video frames 40–339, 103287–103586 of period 2 → 390–689), degraded with `gdkb.augment` (46 `Track N` slots, ball masked on alive frames, duplicates/dropouts). Formats: `docs/spec/data-expectations.md`. Team names and the homography example row are taken from DATA.md; everything else is synthetic. The GT uses the control-rule labels of the source game.
